verdict.rationale: Whether an operating system ships container tooling out of the box is a fair question for macOS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions containers or a built-in container runtime. 'Run Windows on your Mac' is a different capability, and the built-in CLI utilities praised by the community (pbcopy, qlmanage, hidutil) are not container tools.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use container tools out of the box with no additional setup required
